worldcombat.skill.phantomforce.summary: The user tears open a shadow rift, slips into the spirit world and vanishes for a beat, then reappears from a rift behind the target and strikes: at the moment it reappears it shatters every guard on the target, then settles the contact hit. It cannot be seen or hit while vanished, but the target can still walk out of the landing spot.
worldcombat.skill.phantomforce.use.0: Reach through Protect, Light Screen and Wide Guard
worldcombat.skill.phantomforce.use.1: Vanish for a beat to dodge a called-out attack, then hit back up close
worldcombat.skill.phantomforce.descripti: The reappearing strike deals %1$s contact damage.
It vanishes for %1$s, then reappears about %2$s blocks behind the target. It cannot be seen or hit while gone, but the target can still reposition.
At the moment it reappears it shatters up to %1$s guard layers on the target (Protect, Detect, Wide Guard and Harden all use the same guard mechanism), letting the strike land straight through.
worldcombat.skill.phantomforce.deep.on: Deep form: it stays in the rift much longer and shatters one more guard layer, but the strike is lighter and the cooldown longer — safer, yet it gives the target more time to reposition.
worldcombat.skill.phantomforce.deep.off: Skim form: it slips in and out faster and the strike is heavier, but the vanish window is shorter.
worldcombat.skill.phantomforce.timing: Castable within %1$s blocks; after a %2$s wind-up it spends %4$s PP, recovers for %3$s, and goes on cooldown for %5$s from commit.
worldcombat.skill.phantomforce.growth.0: From level %1$s the strike power rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.phantomforce.growth.1: From level %1$s it rises again to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.phantomforce.preferenc: On (Deep): stays in the rift nearly seventy percent longer and shatters one more guard layer, but strike power x0.85 and a longer wind-up and cooldown — safer, yet it gives the target more time to reposition. Off (Skim): slips in and out faster and the strike is heavier, but the vanish window is shorter.
The partner only considers phantom force while a threat is this close; smaller keeps it for close guard-piercing, larger lets it stalk from farther out.
When on, it sharply raises priority against a target carrying any guard, to shatter the shield with this strike first; off keeps it as an ordinary ghost attack.
When the partner's health drops below this ratio it treats phantom force as the vanish that dodges a called-out attack, raising its priority; higher makes it slip away more often when being hit.
